name: Boku wa Mama ni Okasareru
source:
I was living with my father. But he got married with a young, beautiful woman with nice breasts recently. I was so happy to have her as my mother, my heart racing. But my father was transferred to the location far away from us for business.....
I was obsessed with sex with my mom. We had a lot of sex every day....

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ029394.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
原本与父亲相依为命的我，最近迎来了一位年轻貌美、身材傲人的继母。能够拥有这样一位新妈妈令我欣喜若狂、心跳加速。然而不久后，父亲便因工作调动远赴外地单身赴任……
自此我彻底沉溺于与妈妈的鱼水之欢，每天都难舍难分地纠缠在一起……
